rationale: The tape is in genuine conflict: the morning spike to $26.55 has been faded hard (price below the 5-min VWAP at $25.77, signaling short-term sellers), yet price still holds above session VWAP ($24.36) and the open, with the last 25 minutes coiling into a 7-cent range on nearly dead volume (ATR $0.02, 200–900 shares per bar). Direction of the eventual break from this squeeze is a coin flip, and with only 32 minutes to close there is insufficient runway for a resolved move to pay out against any sensible stop. The mechanical evidence supports waiting for a range break rather than guessing one, so no entry this cycle.
